metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2018 · Tumbbad
metas.description: A mythological story about a goddess who created the entire universe. The plot revolves around the consequences when humans build a temple for her first-born.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2018 · Stree
metas.description: In the small town of Chanderi, the menfolk live in fear of an evil spirit named "Stree" who abducts men in the night. Based on the urban legend of "Nale Ba" that went viral in Karnataka in the 1990s.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2007 · Bhool Bhulaiyaa
metas.description: An NRI and his wife decide to stay in his ancestral home, paying no heed to the warnings about ghosts. Soon, inexplicable occurrences cause him to call a psychiatrist to help solve the mystery.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2007 · No Smoking
metas.description: A heavily addicted smoker is unprepared for the true price he must pay when he asks a guru's help to kick the habit.
